notes.title: Spring Surprises Await in Imperia Online!
notes.notes:
Celebrate International Women's Day and More in Imperia Online!

Greetings, Emperors and Empresses!

March is a month of blooming opportunities and thrilling surprises in the expansive world of Imperia Online. As we celebrate International Women’s Day, there's no better time to dive into this epic strategy game and begin your path to greatness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23967971/43fb3affa406759e5449a72f171071d9746f6a47.jpg[/img]

Imperia Online invites new players to the ultimate experience of empire-building. Establish your kingdom, forge alliances, and navigate the intricate world of medieval warfare and diplomacy. Whether you're defending your borders or expanding your realm, every decision you make will shape the destiny of your empire.

As the season transitions with the coming of spring, expect a series of exciting in-game events that are perfect for both new and veteran players. Our calendar is brimming with engaging activities and unique challenges, kicked off by the vibrant festivities of St. Patrick's Day. These events promise to bring fresh adventures and rewards, making it an ideal time to immerse yourself in the game’s thriving community.

Join us in celebrating the strength and achievements of women worldwide as we honor International Women’s Day within Imperia Online. Whether you’re rallying your troops, strategizing with allies, or embarking on new quests, the upcoming weeks promise excitement and new beginnings.

Embark on your journey today, establish your dominion, and make your mark in a vast world teeming with possibilities. Your empire awaits—seize the moment and let the legends speak of your name in Imperia Online!

notes.title: 5 ways to survive Halloween in Imperia Online
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23967971/e9f88f00c8fb6afee69acefc6234da516c4d5c46.jpg[/img]

Every self-respecting ruler in the realms of Imperia Online should properly prepare himself for the upcoming scary holiday, right? If you haven’t experienced these festivities in our game yet, here are some useful tips you should consider, while waiting for the fun to begin:

1. Put on your best Halloween suit – being visible to the rest of the royal community in your realm is important. Having a glowing pumpkin as avatar, for example, can make your enemies take pity on you and not attack you that often… Or not.

2. Prepare lots of treats for your friends and your foes – when you see a foreign army marching towards your empire, the least you can do is writing a message to its owner, informing him you have candies ready for his soldiers.

3. Turn your Royal Palace into Haunted Palace – getting your royal family out of their home and settling them to live among your subjects is always good for your people’s morale. After that you can fill the palace with glowing pumpkins and invite the common folk to tours… and even tax them for tickets! Everybody wins!

4. Make lots of troops – you will need soldiers to replenish your candy stocks, after you spend them for treating the enemy armies, right? Send your army to neutral cities and barbarian camps and you’ll see that they will get a lot of candies!

5. Be there – this is a no-brainer. The Halloween event, called Grim Harvest, starts on Monday, October 31st. Everyone will login to join the fun! Is there any reason for you to not be present?

The time has come for some spooky fun, Your Majesties!

notes.title: Steam Awards 2020
notes.notes:
Good evening [b]Imperials[/b]!

We hope you are well and safe. It's been a tough year, but here we are battling even for the smallest region, reward or victory. 

And while the year proved challenges on all fronts, we managed to deliver a [b]mighty 14 events[/b] to date. This is more than we have ever attempted... and... we are [b]not[/b] finished. We are still pushing for 2 more events, one of which is major. 

We had our [b]15th anniversary[/b] this year, a major milestone in the game's history as well as studio. Coupled with this and the hard work we put in providing 14 events and counting, including [b]2 World Cups[/b], and [b]3[/b] other [b]major tournaments[/b], we would love to show the world why we are best suited to win a Steam Award. 

A recognition of this rank would mean that our game and world we have created in it truly brings joy and happiness to the our players. 

For this reason we would like to urge you to vote for Imperia Online at the upcoming [b]Steam Awards[/b]. The voting will be open until [b]Wednesday the 2nd of December 2020[/b]. 

So rush in, vote and help us show the [b]Imperial might![/b]

notes.title: Imperia Online’s Anniversary World Cup is here to crush you!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23967971/902dec6ab1641fa2b82660a8d1ad4712428785c5.jpg[/img]

“You only become 10-years old once.” – a wise man once said.

And what do you do, when your best and most iconic tournament is 10 years old?

You make sure you let everybody in the world know!

That’s right, folks!

[b]The World Cup[/b] – Imperia Online’s signature tournament has a very special birthday this year!

And we will make sure to celebrate it in kind, by hosting its[b] Anniversary Edition[/b]!

Everything will be Anniversary about it – the rewards, the players, the battles, the emotions!

Judging from how the Exclusive World Cup has ended, we can assume that once again “the usual suspects” will be lined up to grab the Anniversary title.

The defending World Champion Romania will try to hit two rabbits with one stone – third World Title, which will make them the[b] second triple Champion[/b] along with Bulgaria, and, of course – getting the Anniversary gold medal will be something very special.

The upcoming tournament will be interesting for the silver medalist – Egypt. It will show whether the Pharaons will establish themselves as a new Powerhouse in Imperia Online or the second place in World Under Siege was a momentary outburst.

Everybody is asking one very important question though – is the Anniversary World Cup going to be Russia’s moment of glory? Has the time become for them to outdo themselves and go for the gold?

All other countries will have to deal with these questions, puzzles and pressure.

Because there will be a pressure – we guarantee it.

Everyone will want a piece of it. And if that piece is a medal – even better.

All of you, Future World Champions, have [b]9 days[/b] to register for this year’s main event.

The Qualifiers start on[b] October 8th, 3 PM Server Time[/b].

The best 30 players from each nation, who manage to overcome the Qualifiers, will clash in the Group Phase, in order to determine the 30 teams, who go to the Finals and decide who the Anniversary World Champion will be.

What else would you possibly do this fall?

That’s right – the world is now an Anniversary… World Cup!

Good luck, everyone! We are awaiting for you to prove your worth and[b] forge your legacy![/b]

[b]Full tournament info at:[/b] https://worldcup.imperiaonline.org

notes.title: Easter is coming in Imperia Online
Imperia Online Battle Royale II on the Horizon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/23967971/8271587a7349c9e3edb5877650a761248e8de31f.jpg[/img]

You have asked for it.

And we obliged.

Imperia Online Battle Royale is back and it will once again shatter the lands of Imperia!

Weather is getting warmer, nature is waking up from the winter slumber, flowers are blossoming, birds are singing in the trees, love is in the air…

NONE OF THAT MATTERS!

What matters is that all of you, mighty warriors, will be once again pitted against each other in a brutal survival ruleset and there can be only one at the end – THE SOLE SURVIVOR!

So, get ready for a whole new experience in the tournament, as we will make some much needed changes:
 


Total Elimination Phase Overhaul – more players will remain in the tournament after each stage, so more players will fight for the title and more players will cause pain to each other, which is always fun.
Total Ranking Overhaul – now your overall performance and actions during each stage of the tournament will matter more, as we will change the formula, which determines your current ranking position.
 

There will be other changes as well, which we hope will make this onslaught even more exciting.

Expect detailed info in the days to come, but more importantly, get ready to face each other in your favorite hardcore event!

Registrations run between the 31st of March and the 9th of April, so log on and register now to take part in this epic tournament, we will see you there. 

Imperia Online Battle Royale II is coming!

Get ready to brawl!

Real warriors travel.

On foot.

Well, sometimes they ride the horses, but that’s a detail.

The point is – real warriors in Imperia Online travel. A lot.

That’s why we determined that travelling times in Imperia Online have to have real impact, like they did in Medieval Times.

So, no more fixed 10 minutes of travelling no matter where you are located in the realm or relative to your opponent.

From now on these 10 minutes will be added to your travel time, which is determined by your geographical position and your current technology level!

Happy travelling everyone!

notes.title: Can you pull a “royal flush” at this year’s Dominion Rush?
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23967971/7fe1544837a7d029ef5020c14cf514062cf1f959.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]The Time Has Come for New Territories to be Conquered![/b][/h1]

This Friday, August 2nd, 3:00 pm server time, registrations open for Dominion Rush Era 3. Participation is FREE and the rewards are highly coveted: the champion alliance gets 5,000,000 diamonds.

But beware, Dominion Rush is arguably one of the most trying tournaments we organize.
The rules are draconian, strategic alliances are crucial and tactics are decisive. Your spirit, perseverance, wits, and courage are to be tested in unfathomable ways.

[h1]Let’s go over some main points:[/h1]

[h1][list]
[*] Alliances are limited to a maximum of 10 members – choose your allies wisely!
[/list]
[list]
[*] There are 36 conquerable castles on the map – beware, none can be held indefinitely, as the nomad attacks will be with a constantly ascending strength!
[/list]
[list]
[*] A couple of terms to remember
– Allegiance – a model of occupation of an alliance castle
– Conqueror – determines the exact amount of allegiance taken following a successful siege of a castle
[/list]
[list]
[*] Ranking is based on the total score of Defensive points.
[/list][/h1]

If you are up for the challenge, then simply log into the game and register for Dominion Rush! Please note, that only accounts at level 20+ are eligible to participate, or if your account is from version 5 – it has to have more than 500 points.

[h1][b]Your peers are ready… are you?[/b][/h1]

notes.title: [Tournament] Imperia Online goes Battle Royale Mode!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23967971/24e8f60e3b4cd2114a1e6f31e7de0b45fa45ab64.png[/img]

[h1]Imagine a realm with a Deathmatch ruleset – a complete solo PvP hardcore environment, which… shrinks!
[/h1]
No Barbarians, no Castles, no alliances, no distraction whatsoever!

It gets better – players will not only attack each other, but they will also have the option to… destroy each other!

Yes, each time you successfully siege an enemy Fortress, it will drop by a level. And when that level becomes 0, the province is destroyed! And if you manage to do this in the Capital, well… you delete the enemy player and earn a kill point!

To add salt to the injury, each Round in the tournament our beloved System will automatically eliminate players, which didn’t rank high enough!

Until, at the end, there can only be one – The Sole Survivor, who will become the tournament winner!

We dare you to prove your worth!

[b]Imperia Online Battle Royale Registrations and full tournament rules will be launched on May 2nd.[/b]

[h1]In the end there can be only one![/h1]

notes.title: [Tournament] Nomads Invasion: Civil War
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23967971/a96b4936f4c947a226fa5e62b9bb997d0a8c5b3e.jpg[/img]

For the first time in its history the Imperia Online’s cult classic defense tournament will pit the players not only against the Nomad Horde, but against each other!

[h1]General Terms & Conditions: [/h1]
- Start on 04.04.2019 at 14:00 pm, server time [GMT+2].
- Free registration. 
- Only accounts at level 20 or more are eligible to participate.
- All participants will have premium activated for the whole duration of the tournament. 

[h1]Rules of the tournament:[/h1]
-Game speed of Empires’ development - Mega Blitz (x10) – 10 times faster than the normal one.
- All players start with 1 million of each resource and bonus items.
- Attacks between players are allowed but limited. Players can’t attack each other 3 hours before a nomad wave hits and 2 hours after that.
- Espionage between players is allowed.
- Automatic nomad attacks are performed against each player every 10 hours, for a total of 50 waves. The first wave is an exception and will last for 17 hours. It will begin 1 hour after the start of the tournament.
- Each nomad wave will hit in an exact hour according to a schedule. The schedule for all 50 waves will be available to all participants ingame. 

[h1]Rewards:[/h1]
- Players at the top 3 places will receive the biggest rewards of the tournament - medals and diamonds. Diamond rewards are distributed as follows: 1st place - 2 125 000 diamonds, 2nd place - 1 275 000 diamonds, 3rd place - 850 000 diamonds.
- Players ranking in the next 50 places after top 3 will receive vouchers for 85 000 diamonds each.
- Special rewards will be given in 9 additional categories.
[b]
Full tournament info can be found [url=http://nomads.imperiaonline.org/en/rules/]here[/url].[/b]

[h1]The Times of Madness have come![/h1]

notes.title: [Update] New achievement system and more!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23967971/834115d6f7c898a3ecdacc04f6ba7b8874a66f38.png[/img]

Greetings, noble Emperors!

The new achievement system has come, together with other exciting features:
 
[h1][b]New achievement system[/b] [/h1]
You can chose to pursue 30 different achievements representing your military and economic power.

[h1][b]Barbarians 2.0[/b][/h1]
Major changes affecting the barbarian camps density and number of attacks each player can do in a single day.

[h1][b]Global chat[/b][/h1]
Global chat is available now in all realms. Tell players from all over the world about your recent victory now.

[b]Time to step up your game. Good luck![/b]

notes.title: [Event] Women's Day and Saint Patrick's Day
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23967971/fe0bdd481a940dfca28092cd87de3fce8f467478.jpg[/img]


The Spring is here! You can feel it in the air. You can sense it everywhere around you. You can also see it in Imperia Online’s schedule, because it’s full of events!

[h1]International Women’s Day (March 8-10) [/h1]
First it’s the International Women’s Day on March 8th. The time has come to celebrate our Queens, Amazons and Princesses!
Therefore let it be known that between March 8th and March 10th we will gift all our players with 308 free items! All you need to do is log into the game and receive your present!


 [h1]St. Patrick’s Day (March 15-18)[/h1]
Then comes St. Patrick’s Day, where you can really turn your luck!
There will be many challenges waiting for you between March 15th and 18th and if you make the Gods of Fortune happy, they will smile upon your Empire and… some of them might even crash your party in the tavern!

[h1]So, there’s only one thing left for you to do, fellas – log into Imperia Online and join the coming of Spring![/h1]
